return_text:
**As of 25 September 2026, I would benchmark these five in order.** This ranks suitability for your harness and deployment. All scores below are vendor/maintainer reports; I found no independent reproduction matching your exact local configuration. Adapter descriptions are engineering proposals, not tested integrations.

1. **Hindsight — strongest complete shared-memory candidate.** [MIT repository](https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight); latest [v0.10.1, September 21](https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/releases/tag/v0.10.1), including Codex transcript/timestamp fixes. Documented [Claude Code/Codex hooks and MCP](https://hindsight.vectorize.io/sdks/integrations/coding-agents) provide automatic capture. Supports [Ollama/OpenAI-compatible inference](https://hindsight.vectorize.io/developer/configuration); operational weight is API/worker plus [PostgreSQL and vector extension](https://hindsight.vectorize.io/developer/installation).

   **Evidence:** [December 14, 2025 paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2512.12818v1): LongMemEval-S **91.4% QA**, LoCoMo **89.61%**, Gemini-3 Pro answers, GPT-OSS-120B memory/judge. Current [manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vectorize-io/agent-memory-benchmark/main/results-manifest.json) reports **94.6%/92.01%** respectively and BEAM-10M single-query **64.08%**; exact run date/model are missing.

   **Adapter/risk:** [Retain](https://hindsight.vectorize.io/developer/api/retain) timestamped sessions as separate documents; aggregate [ranked facts’ document IDs](https://hindsight.vectorize.io/developer/api/recall) into sessions. Extraction cost and accuracy with your smaller local models remain unmeasured.

2. **Attemory — strongest directly relevant reported retrieval result; conditional on dependency verification.** [MIT repository](https://github.com/AttemorySystem/attemory); latest [v0.1.3, August 13](https://github.com/AttemorySystem/attemory/releases), evidencing continuing releases.

   **Evidence:** Undated [benchmark files](https://github.com/AttemorySystem/attemory/blob/main/benchmarks/LongMemEval.md), checked today: **96.38% session recall_all@5**, cleaned LongMemEval-S/470, local Qwen3.5-9B; **83.62%** on M. These are retrieval scores, without an answer model. [LoCoMo QA](https://github.com/AttemorySystem/attemory): **94.52%**, GPT-4.1-mini answers/GPT-4o-mini judge; run date missing.

   **Adapter/risk:** Reuse dated-turn ingestion and session deduplication; match assistant-turn inclusion across controls. [Runtime](https://github.com/AttemorySystem/attemory/blob/main/doc/usage.md) requires its own local Qwen/GGUF service and KV storage, outside your Ollama/OpenAI endpoint convention. Claude integration covers code search; MCP remains planned and automatic dual-client capture is unverified. The required [prebuilt core SDK](https://github.com/AttemorySystem/attemory/blob/main/CMakeLists.txt) leaves full source/licence coverage unverified.

3. **GBrain — auditable retrieval challenger with native client support.** [MIT repository](https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain); latest [v0.56.2.0, September 24](https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain/releases/tag/v0.56.2.0), with active indexing/sync fixes.

   **Evidence:** [September 6 evaluation](https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain-evals/blob/main/docs/benchmarks/2026-09-06-longmemeval-ranker-wave.md), v0.48.4.0: cleaned S, **449/470 = 95.53% all-session coverage within five chunks**. Uses OpenAI text-embedding-3-large and Voyage rerank-2.5; five chunks differ from five distinct sessions. Separate **86.6% QA** uses Sonnet 4.6/GPT-4o judging. Equivalent local scores are missing.

   **Adapter/risk:** [Ollama providers](https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain/blob/master/docs/integrations/embedding-providers.md), Bun and embedded PGLite support local deployment. [Claude/Codex MCP and capture](https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain/blob/master/docs/guides/bootstrap.md) require bootstrap; Codex capture is SessionEnd-only. Preserve timestamps/session IDs, over-fetch chunks and deduplicate in returned order. Use one shared server owner. Published results depend on hosted models; the latest release also acknowledges an unresolved macOS reindex hang.

4. **Mem0 OSS — useful extraction-plus-hybrid baseline.** [Apache-2.0 repository](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0); latest Python [v2.2.0, September 23](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/releases), following September 18 updates.

   **Evidence:** Undated [OSS results](https://github.com/mem0ai/memory-benchmarks): LongMemEval-S **91.0% QA**, GPT-5 extraction/answer/judge, Qwen-600M embeddings. Published **94.4% LongMemEval, 92.5% LoCoMo**, and BEAM-1M/10M average scores **0.641/0.486** belong to the managed platform.

   **Adapter/risk:** [Ollama](https://docs.mem0.ai/components/llms/models/ollama) is supported; benchmark infrastructure uses API plus Qdrant. Native capture plugins target the cloud ([Claude](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/issues/7105), [Codex](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/blob/main/docs/integrations/codex.mdx)); local capture needs glue. Use fresh collections, source-session metadata and session aggregation. Encode dates in text/metadata because [OSS rejects native timestamp parameters](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/blob/main/mem0/memory/main.py). Cloud/OSS feature and score differences are material.

5. **OpenViking — integration-focused comparison.** [AGPL-3.0 repository](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking); latest [v0.4.21, September 20](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/releases), following September 14. Offers native [Claude](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/agent-integrations/02-claude-code)/[Codex](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/agent-integrations/04-codex) hooks+MCP, [Ollama/OpenAI-compatible providers](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/guides/01-configuration), and a server with embedded storage.

   **Evidence:** [May 29 report](https://blog.openviking.ai/post/openviking-benchmark-results/), v0.3.22: LoCoMo **80.32% QA with Claude Code**, Doubao 2.0 Pro VLM; separately identified answer model missing. A [LongMemEval harness](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/tree/main/benchmark/longmemeval/openviking) exists, but no verified published score was located.

   **Adapter/risk:** Ingest timestamped sessions; maintain URI→session provenance and aggregate [ranked URI hits](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/concepts/07-retrieval). Risks are AGPL requirements, provenance through extraction, and Codex hook/version restrictions.

For all five, use the [official evaluator](https://github.com/xiaowu0162/LongMemEval/blob/main/src/retrieval/run_retrieval.py): fresh stores, gold labels excluded from ingestion, identical role inclusion, and five distinct returned sessions. Measure ingestion cost and latency alongside recall. No verified MemoryAgentBench results were located for these five.
